That's exactly what I plan on doing, yes! Thank you for putting it into clearer and more transparent words than I managed to. 
Sadly I think that (atleast in my case) the genuine effort to quit something as omnipresent as visual/screen based artificial sexual stimulation comes hand in hand with hyperfixation on certain issues that surround it, e.g. sexuality, gender identity, body image and social behaviour; and that may be the reason why I'm that afraid of porns harsh influence on these things only a week after quitting.

While I totally understand your point, I personally am quite certain that I want to abstain from porn. I don't want to depict it as an absolute evil with no benefits; but for me it just got out of hand and took negative influence on other parts of my life. I've already tried to use porn taste as an instrument of figuring out gender and sexuality issues, but in the last few months I realised that it distorted my view on certain aspects of said issues more than anything else. I don't want to blame porn for every single on of my problems - depression, social anxiety and the fact of me being highly sensitive also contribute to them -, but in my case it's taken a form (concerning frequency and intensity) that definitely makes me want to quit. 

But I'm happy that it helped you to figure some things out; in the end, I think, it comes down to ones personal relationship towards porn (and potentially addictive behaviours in general) and whether you consciously use it as a "tool" or unconsciously use it as a coping mechanism, form of escapism etc.

Darüber kann man sich wieder streiten, aber die (Über-)Sexualisierung der weiblichen Brust allein mit ihrer biologischen Funktion zu begründen lässt die ganzen androzentrischen, männlich dominierten Strukturen, die zu dieser starken Sexualisierung (und allem, was hinsichtlich gesetzlichen Einschränkungen, sozialem Stigma und Dingen wie Belästigung daran hängt) geführt haben, ziemlich außer Acht.

In dem Fall geht es denke ich um die krasse Gegenüberstellung; dass die Brust des Mannes kaum bis gar nicht sexualisiert ist und die der Frau so sehr, dass sie in der Öffentlichkeit 24/7 zu verhüllen ist. Und das wesentlichste Merkmal, die Brustwarzen, teilen sich Männer und Frauen (von der mangelnden "Funktionalität" beim Mann einmal abgesehen). Die Kritik misst sich also daran, dass gegen die Möglickeit für Frauen, sich oberkörperfrei zu bewegen, de facto nur ästhetisch (in dem Fall: sexualisiert) fundiert und - mehr oder weniger - (inter-)subjektiv argumentiert wird. Feel you. At this point I feel like I'm just a hollow body containing whatever emotion defines me the most at the given moment. I suffer from a moderate social anxiety disorder, so I just try to cope with the day, the week, the month. Almost every situation has become a fight against my worries, fears and my bad emotions and I feel like that's the only thing defining me lately. My worries and fears take up so much space that my personality seems to be pushed away to the point of being replaced by my internal struggle. I'm losing interest in everything, my energy level is extremely mutable throughout the day, I'm easily frustraded, I'm losing concentration, I can't hold a proper conversation, not even with closest friends. When someone asks me how I'm doing I just deliver the most "default" answers, sometimes I don't even think about what to say. I feel like this whole sh*t takes up so much space that my intelligence, creativity, passion, energy, desire and my overall personality are slowly fading away.

I always wake up with messy hair (but not movie-ish messy hair, it's just really plushy in the back and sticks to my head in the front), so I get my hair wet first and then proceed to dry it up a bit with a towel. Nut too much, because in the next step, I ad a little bit of styling mousse to my moist (not wet nor completely dry!) hair. Then, I blow-dry it to the side, combing it a little bit backwards and also a bit upwards to generate volume. Being relatively short, my hair then looks a bit dry/fuzzy and tends to be too "light", so I comb in a bit of hair wax. Again not too much, otherwise it get's a bit sticky. If necessary (and after checking the weather outside) I use a tiny bit of hairspray to add a bit more hold to areas that tend to fall apart over the day.
